paper_title: Axion-Like Particles and Recent Observations of the Cosmic Infrared Background Radiation
notes: Paper identifies an ALLOWED region (not exclusion) in (m_a, g_agamma) plane that resolves tension between CIBER CIB data and TeV gamma-ray observations. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (g_agamma in GeV^-1). The favored region is m_a ~ 7e-10 to 5e-8 eV and g_agamma ~ 1.5e-11 to 8.8e-10 GeV^-1 (95% C.L.). Specific fit example used g_agamma=3.2e-11 GeV^-1, m_a=3.2e-9 eV.
